english.title: Vehicle - holder of trade licence permit display of mutilated / defaced / altered / added to etc plate

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES REGISTRATION AND LICENSING REGULATIONS 2002

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a trade licence, permitted another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OTHER PERSON..), to exhibit on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), a trade plate

(A)_[which had been altered]_
(B)_[which had been defaced]_
(C)_[which had been mutilated]_
(D)_[which had been added to]_
(E)_[the figures or particulars of which had become illegible]_
(F)_[the colour of which had altered whether by fading or otherwise]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 3 of Schedule 6 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(b) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes: This offence document replaces RV02032 from 1st October 2014. For any offences of this nature committed before this date, RV02032 should be used (H4964).
